nodes.label: src_device_assignments
nodes.raw_sql:
-- Source model: src_device_assignments
-- Note: After editing query logic, run dbt run --full-refresh
{{
    config(
        materialized='streaming_table',
        distributed_by={'columns': ['assignment_id'], 'buckets': 1},
        with={
            'changelog.mode': 'append',
            'kafka.cleanup-policy': 'delete',
            'scan.bounded.mode': 'unbounded',
            'scan.startup.mode': 'earliest-offset',
            'value.format': 'avro-registry'
        }
    )
}}

SELECT
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.assignment_id, after.assignment_id), 'UNKNOWN') AS assignment_id,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.patient_id, after.patient_id), 'UNKNOWN') AS patient_id,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.device_id, after.device_id), 'UNKNOWN') AS device_id,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.care_area_id, after.care_area_id), 'UNKNOWN') AS care_area_id,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.bed_label, after.bed_label), 'UNASSIGNED') AS bed_label,
    coalesce(IF(op = 'd', before.status, after.status), 'ACTIVE') AS status,
    `$rowtime` AS event_ts
FROM {{ source('cdc', 'device_assignments') }}
WHERE op != 'd'

nodes.label: dim_patients
nodes.raw_sql:
-- Dimension model: dim_patients
-- Note: After editing query logic, run dbt run --full-refresh
{{
    config(
        materialized='streaming_table',
        distributed_by={'columns': ['patient_id'], 'buckets': 1},
        with={
            'changelog.mode': 'append',
            'kafka.cleanup-policy': 'delete',
            'scan.bounded.mode': 'unbounded',
            'scan.startup.mode': 'earliest-offset',
            'value.format': 'avro-registry'
        }
    )
}}

SELECT
    p.patient_id,
    p.full_name,
    p.gender,
    p.birth_date,
    p.risk_tier,
    p.primary_condition,
    p.status,
    coalesce(g.normal_hr_min, 60) AS guideline_hr_min,
    coalesce(g.normal_hr_max, 100) AS guideline_hr_max,
    coalesce(g.normal_spo2_min, 95.0) AS guideline_spo2_min,
    p.event_ts
FROM {{ ref('src_patients') }} AS p
LEFT JOIN LATERAL SNAPSHOT(
    input => TABLE {{ ref('ref_vital_guidelines') }},
    on_time => DESCRIPTOR(p.event_ts),
    load_completed_idle_timeout => INTERVAL '1' MINUTE
) AS g ON p.risk_tier = g.risk_tier

nodes.label: fct_patient_vitals_summary
nodes.raw_sql:
-- Fact model: fct_patient_vitals_summary
-- Materialized table (upsert, compacted) for low-latency RTCE and snapshot queries
-- Note: After editing query logic, run dbt run --full-refresh
{{
    config(
        materialized='materialized_table',
        distributed_by={'columns': ['patient_id'], 'buckets': 1},
        with={
            'changelog.mode': 'upsert',
            'connector': 'confluent',
            'kafka.cleanup-policy': 'compact',
            'value.format': 'avro-registry'
        }
    )
}}

SELECT
    patient_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_telemetry_events,
    CAST(AVG(heart_rate) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_heart_rate,
    MIN(heart_rate) AS min_heart_rate,
    MAX(heart_rate) AS max_heart_rate,
    CAST(AVG(spo2) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_spo2,
    MIN(spo2) AS min_spo2,
    MAX(spo2) AS max_spo2,
    MAX(event_ts) AS last_telemetry_ts
FROM {{ ref('src_telemetry_events') }}
GROUP BY patient_id

        with={
            'changelog.mode': 'upsert',
            'connector': 'confluent',
            'kafka.cleanup-policy': 'compact',

}}

SELECT
    p.patient_id,
    p.full_name,
    p.gender,
    p.birth_date,
    p.risk_tier,
    p.primary_condition,
    p.status AS patient_status,
    coalesce(v.total_telemetry_events, 0) AS total_telemetry_events,
    coalesce(v.avg_heart_rate, 75.0) AS avg_heart_rate,
    coalesce(v.avg_spo2, 98.0) AS avg_spo2,
    v.last_telemetry_ts,
    p.event_ts AS profile_updated_ts
FROM {{ ref('dim_patients') }} AS p
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('fct_patient_vitals_summary') }} AS v
    ON p.patient_id = v.patient_id
